title: Resource-Adaptive Stochastic Gradient Descent for Online Linear Programming without Re-solving
summary: The growth of large language model (LLM) inference and search services increases the scale of online linear programming problems, motivating computationally efficient algorithms. We develop resource-adaptive stochastic gradient descent (RASGD) for stochastic online linear programming. The algorithm uses one request and current inventory to update resource prices, requiring O(m) operations for m resources and memory per arrival and no LP or sample-average optimization.
